articles.summary: A multi-vehicle crash in Etobicoke has sent two people to hospital.

articles.title: ICE officer shoots a man while making an arrest in New York, officials say
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — A federal immigration officer shot and wounded a Dominican man while arresting him in New York City on Thursday, during what the Department of Homeland Security called a “targeted enforcement operation.” Protesters and local officials decried it as an example of the dangers of the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.

articles.title: Ontario will officially begin removing Toronto bike lanes on Tuesday
articles.summary: Ontario will begin removing bike lanes from a stretch on Bloor Street W. in Etobicoke on Tuesday, the Ministry of Transportation says.

articles.title: Oshawa museum faces nearly $3K in city fines over homeless encampments on property
articles.summary: A charity that runs a museum in Oshawa has received nearly $3,000 in city fines for allowing "nuisance activity" on its property. It says it needs help, not penalties, to keep the museum safe from vandalism, trespassing and damage.

articles.title: Man dead after industrial accident in Brampton, police say
articles.summary: A man is dead after an industrial accident in Brampton on Wednesday, Peel police say.

articles.title: How transit expansion is driving the Scarborough North municipal election
articles.summary: Toronto city council races are heating up, and Ward 23 Scarborough North is a key one to watch. With major transit infrastructure being built and plans for subways extending further into the area, the ward is undergoing massive change. CBC’s Dale Manucdoc breaks down the race and who is running to represent the community.

articles.title: New documentary about Ridgeway Plaza tackles its negative reputation
articles.summary: 'Meet Me At Ridgeway,' a new film by Mississauga residents, explores the controversial plaza's cultural richness, challenges, opportunities for voter engagement and takeaways for urban planners and the City of Mississauga.
